display_long_description:
Enter VIRTUVASION — a fast-paced neon VR arcade wave shooter inspired by classic arcade games and retro sci-fi aesthetics.

Defend the shield on a floating platform in a massive neon grid world while relentless alien swarms attack from every direction. Blast through endless enemy waves, survive as long as possible and climb the leaderboards in intense VR combat built for replayability and high-score chasing.

Use dual blasters, charge powerful energy shots, switch to rifle mode and recharge your shield to survive increasingly overwhelming enemy waves.

FEATURES
• Fast-paced VR arcade combat
• Endless wave-based survival gameplay
• Global and friends leaderboards
• Dual blasters and charge beam mechanics
• Blaster rifle mode
• Shield recharge mechanics
• Retro-inspired neon sci-fi visuals
• Snap turn and smooth turn comfort options

EARLY ACCESS
VIRTUVASION is currently in active Early Access development. Additional gameplay systems, enemies, weapons, progression features and overall polish are planned for future updates.
